dedupe_keys.name: mps19 seismic hazard model of italy results

description: The Italian National Institute of Geophysics and Volcanology seismic-hazard team publishes MPS19 model results for Italy. Zenodo lists fifteen spreadsheet and documentation files under CC BY 4.0 with free access. The 0.05-degree grid covers Italy and reports peak and spectral acceleration at several periods, means and selected uncertainty percentiles for ten probabilities of exceedance in 50 years, on Eurocode 8 class-A rock. These values can drive probabilistic shaking and infrastructure loss simulations or compare hazard alternatives. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these MPS19 outputs. They are modelled ground motions, not observed damage or a site-adjusted response spectrum. Rock-site assumptions, rupture forecasts and ground-motion choices need the cited MPS19 method documentation. The sheets were not downloaded, so formulae, row count and values were not independently checked.
